title: Cover pinned-submodule revalidation races and malformed gitlink refusals
outcome: Deterministic disposable tests fail if post-capture gitlink, exclusion-policy or checkout revalidation is removed, and cover malformed, duplicate and unsafe gitlink parsing without relying on unrelated refusal paths.
acceptance: Barrier-driven tests mutate a gitlink, committed exclusion policy or checkout between capture phases and verify that the resulting basis is refused for the intended revalidation guard.
Targeted malformed, duplicate and unsafe gitlink fixtures establish their preconditions and fail for the intended path or identity validation guard.
The final exact change passes required review, tests and independent acceptance before completion.
